summary: Bump golang.org/x/text to v0.39.0 and the go directive to 1.26.6 to clear reachable vulnerabilities.
reason: govulncheck reported GO-2026-5970 (x/text infinite loop) reachable from learn.JournalInvocation and store.UpsertBatch, plus four reachable stdlib vulns on go1.26.5 including a crypto/tls post-handshake DoS (GO-2026-6090) and net/url quadratic complexity (GO-2026-6218). 1.26.6 is the exact fix floor for all four and matches the library CI toolchain, which runs GOTOOLCHAIN=local and cannot download a newer one.
validated_outcome: govulncheck: 'No vulnerabilities found' from both the source tree and the packaged library module.
